item.name: Dustpan_and_Brush
item.description: Small hand brush and dustpan used on communal tables.
item.readyBeforeUse: The brush and dustpan have no visible dirt or trash.
item.readyForNextPerson: The dustpan is empty, the brush and dustpan have no visible dirt or trash, and the brush is with the dustpan.
item.ifNotReady: Empty the dustpan into 📦 Trash_Bins. If visible dirt or trash remains, use 🍳 Disposable_Towels to collect dry debris from the tables and tell the Dominatrix.
